metadata.description: Public Claude Code and Codex plugin marketplace for reusable agent workflows, engineering skills, and Rust tooling

plugins.name: dwind
plugins.description: Skills for building UIs with the dwind/dominator/futures-signals Rust+WASM stack

plugins.name: rust-architecture
plugins.description: Opinionated Rust project structuring — workspace layout, DI patterns, testing strategy, and CI tooling

plugins.name: rust-api-stack
plugins.description: Skills for building type-safe Rust API Stack services with REST, JSON-RPC, file, and WebSocket APIs via macro-driven code generation

plugins.name: rust-app-scaffolds
plugins.description: Rust application scaffolds for full-stack web apps with Rust API Stack plus dwind and desktop apps with Tauri 2 plus dwind

plugins.name: bevy
plugins.description: Skills for writing Bevy games against the current API: names that changed up to Bevy 0.20, checking signatures against local source, and runtime debugging

plugins.name: mathias-voice
plugins.description: Mathias's writing voice for documentation, READMEs, decision records, video scripts and lessons, as a drafting skill plus a Claude Code output style

plugins.name: blender
plugins.description: Connect Claude Code and Codex to Blender through the community blender-mcp server

plugins.name: ashlar
plugins.description: Skills for using the ashlar crates in a Bevy game: procedural buildings and PBR materials authored in Rust, baked by a content step, loaded with AshlarPlugin

plugins.name: code-quality
plugins.description: Audit the quality of a Rust codebase from measurements: complexity, coverage, CRAP, churn, change coupling, duplication and advisories, ranked so the agent reads the risky code first
